full_text:
## I. General Questions About Animal Feed Additives

Q: What are animal feed additives?
A: Substances added to feed to improve nutrition, health, growth, or product quality.

Q: Why are feed additives used in poultry and dairy diets?
A: To improve feed efficiency, enhance growth, prevent diseases, and improve product quality.

Q: Are feed additives the same as nutrients?
A: No — additives aren't primary nutrients (proteins/carbs), but support nutrition and health.

Q: Who regulates feed additives in India?
A: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) and Fertiliser and Chemicals regulations.

Q: Are all feed additives legal in India?
A: No — only those permitted by FSSAI and other regulatory bodies.

Q: What forms do feed additives come in?
A: Powders, liquids, pellets, microcapsules.

Q: Do additives replace vaccines?
A: No. They support immunity but are not substitutes for vaccines.

Q: Do feed additives change feed taste?
A: Some do (flavors/appetizers) to increase palatability.

Q: Are additives species-specific?
A: Many are — poultry, cattle, buffalo, goats require different formulations.

Q: How are feed additives labeled?
A: With ingredient, dosage, warnings, manufacturing and expiry date.
